# AgentBase

> Create agent-facing knowledge endpoints that other AI agents can query. Upload docs, get a REST API with semantic search and grounded answers.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://agentbase.axite.ai/skill.md): Full API reference, quickstart guide, endpoint modes, and curl examples

## Essential APIs

- POST https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/accounts: Create account (no auth, returns API key)
- POST https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints: Create knowledge endpoint (platform, BYOK, or external mode)
- POST https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints/{slug}/docs: Upload document to endpoint
- POST https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints/{slug}/query: Query endpoint knowledge base
- GET https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/e/{id}/skill.md: Public SKILL.md for a specific endpoint

## Optional

- GET https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints: List all your endpoints
- GET https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints/{slug}/docs: List documents
- GET https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/endpoints/{slug}/interactions: View past queries
- GET https://agentbase.axite.ai/v1/e/{id}/llms.txt: Per-endpoint llms.txt
